==============================================================================
  APEX RADIANCE {VERSION}
  Lighting, picture and performance for The Sims 3
==============================================================================

  What is in this zip

    ApexRadianceSetup.exe ...... the installer (recommended)
    Manual install\ ............ the mod files, to install them by hand


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OPTION 1  -  INSTALL WITH APEX RADIANCE SETUP  (recommended)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    1.  Close The Sims 3 and its launcher.
    2.  Run ApexRadianceSetup.exe.
    3.  Pick your game, then click Install.

  That's it. Setup finds the game (Steam or EA app), installs Apex
  Radiance and everything it needs, and checks your other mods.

  Later, run Setup again to:

    -  update with one click
    -  check that everything is in place
    -  repair or remove
    -  undo a change (Setup keeps a restore point before every change)


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OPTION 2  -  INSTALL BY HAND
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Open the "Manual install" folder and follow "How to install.txt".


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AFTER INSTALLING
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Start the game, load a world and press  Ctrl + Shift + F11  to open
  the Apex Radiance menu.

  Your settings are kept between updates, in:
    Documents\Electronic Arts\The Sims 3\Apex Radiance


  Help, bug reports and every version:
    https://github.com/loinyx/Sims3-ApexRadiance
